facts.fact: The Information Regulator issued an enforcement notice and an infringement notice against Blouberg Local Municipality and imposed a R500,000 fine, which the Polokwane High Court reduced to R250,000 in a section 109(5) confirmation in early April 2026.
The Regulator's media statement names its chairperson, a full-time member, a part-time member and its chief executive officer.
